vectors.description: draft-mzanaty-moq-loc-05 2.3 declares an even type's value as Length bytes, but its [MoQTransport], draft-ietf-moq-transport-10 9.1.1.2, frames an even type's value as one varint. Audio Level (2.3.3.1) declares 1 byte, the level in 7 bits; the varint 127 cannot be that, so the value is left uninterpreted.
